items.quote: Considering that the samples have been annealed at 750 °C for 70 days, the DSC device was carried out in Al2O3 crucibles with heating rate of 10 °C/min from 25 °C to 760 °C, 5 °C/min from 760 °C to 1350 °C, and cooling rate of 10 °C/min from 1350 °C to 25 °C. One part was analyzed by inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES, IRIS Advantage DUO, Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., Waltham, MA, USA), X-ray diffractometer (XRD, Bruker-AXS D8), scanning electron microscope (SEM, FEI XL30S, FEI Company, Portland, OR, USA), and electron probe micro-analyzer (EPMA, JXA-8100, JEOL, Japan) to determine the microstructure and composition of as-cast alloys.

The alloy samples were prepared with high-purity Ag (99.9 wt%), Cr (99.95 wt%), and Zr (99.9 wt%) by melting them in the arcmelting furnace in a high purity argon atmosphere. Each sample was turned over and re-melted at least three times to guarantee homogeneity.
